display_long_description:
# Welcome to Meow Mart! 🐾
Join our **Discord** and become a Shareholder — vote on what we build next!
**https://discord.gg/at5QaPDjvg**

Step into VR and run the coziest supermarket ever! **Meow Mart** blends immersive first-person shop management with an addictive cat breeding system. 

[media]

🛒 **Immersive First-Person Management**
Experience the tactile satisfaction of running a store! Unlock a massive variety of products to fill your shelves. Physically restock items, ring up customers, and manage your daily profits. Earn money to expand your floor plan, turning your small shop into the ultimate bustling mega-mart.

🐈 **Breed & Collect 30 Feline Variations**
Start your feline empire with **6 distinct breeds and 30 beautiful coat variations**! Master the breeding economics: carefully plan your pairings (males breed 5x, females 3x) to hatch new kittens, unlock them all, and complete your ultimate feline collection!

[media]

✨ **Strategic Pet Economy & Collection**
Your cats are valuable assets! Sell them for massive profits to fund your store expansions and unlock even more goods, or keep your absolute favorites in 4 designated "Cat Zones" (holding up to 40 cats). Watch them interact in your store and enjoy their cozy companionship while you work!

🏠 **The Giant Rooftop Cat**
Step outside and look up! A massive, sleeping giant cat rests on your roof. It's the ultimate cozy landmark for your retail empire.
